headline: A firmware flaw in Coinkite's Coldcard hardware wallet let a thief sweep 1,082 bitcoin worth about $70 million from 1,196 addresses in 41 minutes.

emerging_trends.text: A thief who exploited a firmware weakness in the Coldcard wallet swept about $70 million in bitcoin in 41 minutes, a scale of loss that pushes hardware-wallet firmware into the front rank of financial risk.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Coldcard Firmware Flaw Fuels $70 Million Bitcoin Heist

emerging_trends.text: Adform's poisoned advertising script, which rewrote copied cryptocurrency wallet addresses across client sites, shows criminals turning trusted third-party code into a quiet payments-hijacking channel.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Adform Script Poisoning Swaps Crypto Wallet Addresses

emerging_trends.text: Phishing crews now impersonate ChatGPT and other AI services, betting that users fear losing access to the tools they lean on daily.

topics.title: Coldcard Firmware Flaw Fuels $70 Million Bitcoin Heist
topics.latest_developments: Galaxy Research mapped a July 30 sweep that drained 1,196 Bitcoin addresses in 41 minutes, taking 1,082.65 bitcoin worth about $70.2 million, and tied it to a firmware flaw in Coinkite's Coldcard wallet.
topics.summary: A March 2021 firmware integration error at Canadian maker Coinkite routed Coldcard seed generation to a deterministic software pseudorandom number generator, making the private keys guessable; owners of wallets set up under that firmware should move funds to freshly generated keys.

sources.title: Coldcard Hardware Wallet Flaw Linked to $70 Million Bitcoin Theft in 41 Minutes

topics.title: Adform Script Poisoning Swaps Crypto Wallet Addresses
topics.latest_developments: The Hacker News detailed the compromise: Adform detected the tampered JavaScript on July 27, 2026, removed it, notified affected clients, and reported the incident to authorities.
topics.summary: Attackers modified a JavaScript file that advertising-technology firm Adform serves across customer sites, turning it into a browser-side tool that rewrites copied cryptocurrency wallet addresses; anyone who visited an affected site on July 27 and copied a Bitcoin address should verify the destination before sending funds.

sources.title: Hackers Poison Adform Script to Swap Crypto Wallet Addresses Across Customer Sites

topics.title: Phishing Campaigns Impersonate AI Providers
topics.latest_developments: SANS Internet Storm Center flagged phishing emails that impersonate AI services such as ChatGPT, pressing recipients with the fear of losing access to lure clicks.
topics.summary: Attackers have added AI-service brands to their impersonation roster, mimicking ChatGPT and similar providers to steal credentials; treat unexpected AI-account warnings as suspect and reach the service through its own site.

sources.title: Phishing Campaigns Targeting AI Solutions Providers, (Sat, Aug 1st)

topics.title: Defcon Badge Doubles as an Inspectable Security Key
topics.latest_developments: Ars Technica reported that Defcon's new badge is a working hardware security key whose removable chip attendees can inspect and keep using after the conference.
topics.summary: The Defcon badge, long a hacker collectible, now ships as a functioning hardware security key with a transparent design that lets researchers examine the silicon; attendees can register it for two-factor authentication and carry it beyond the event.

sources.title: Defcon's new badge is a security key you can see inside

around_town.title: Springdale Plans New Community Celebration
around_town.latest_developments: Springdale borough officials launched a new community celebration tied to the borough's and the nation's anniversaries, filling the void left when the town's annual carnival folded years ago.
around_town.summary: Springdale, the Allegheny River borough in Allegheny County, is starting a community celebration to spotlight the town after its longtime annual carnival ended, borough officials told TribLive.

around_town.title: North Fayette Firefighter Rescues Ducklings
around_town.latest_developments: A North Fayette Township volunteer firefighter, headed to Home Depot for a home-improvement project, stopped Saturday to free five ducklings trapped in a storm drain.
around_town.summary: A North Fayette Township Volunteer Fire Department firefighter pulled five ducklings from a storm drain in Allegheny County on Saturday after spotting them while running an errand, WPXI and WTAE reported.

around_teams.title: Pirates Acquire Camilo Doval From Yankees
around_teams.latest_developments: The Pirates made their first trade-deadline move, landing former All-Star closer Camilo Doval from the New York Yankees for two prospects and cash to shore up the bullpen.
around_teams.summary: Pittsburgh acquired right-handed reliever Camilo Doval, a onetime All-Star with 109 career saves, from the New York Yankees for a pair of minor leaguers, the Pirates' opening bid for bullpen help at the deadline, the Post-Gazette reported.

sources.title: The Pirates make their first deadline bullpen addition, acquiring right-hander Camilo Doval from the Yankees

around_teams.title: O'Hearn to Miss Six to Eight Weeks
around_teams.latest_developments: The Pirates placed Ryan O'Hearn on the 10-day injured list with a left quad strain and now expect him to miss six to eight weeks, after he pulled up running to first base Friday in Cincinnati.
around_teams.summary: First baseman and right fielder Ryan O'Hearn grabbed his left leg running to first against the Cincinnati Reds and landed on the injured list, a six-to-eight-week absence that thins an already banged-up Pirates lineup, the Post-Gazette reported.

sources.title: Pirates lose another star to injury, as Ryan O'Hearn is expected to miss 6-8 weeks

around_teams.title: Steelers Name 2026 Hall of Honor Class
around_teams.latest_developments: The Steelers announced their 2026 Hall of Honor class, inducting the late lineman and broadcaster Craig Wolfley, former general manager Kevin Colbert, and 1970s defensive back J.T. Thomas.
around_teams.summary: Pittsburgh will enshrine three new Hall of Honor members: Craig Wolfley, the offensive lineman turned team broadcaster who died recently; Kevin Colbert, the general manager who built the roster for two decades; and J.T. Thomas, a cornerback on the 1970s Super Bowl teams, the Post-Gazette reported.

sources.title: The late Craig Wolfley will be among the inductees in the Steelers' 2026 Hall of Honor class
